objective: Create a new page using a template on Notion.
notes: Ensure you are logged into your Notion account.

steps.title: Select a Workspace
steps.action: Choose the desired workspace where you want to create the page.

steps.title: Access Templates
steps.action: Click on the 'Templates' button or option.
steps.expected_result: A list of available templates is displayed.

steps.title: Choose a Template
steps.action: Select a template from the list.
steps.expected_result: The template is opened for customization.

steps.title: Create the Page
steps.action: Fill in the necessary details and save the new page.
steps.expected_result: A new page is created using the selected template.

success_criteria: The new page is successfully created in the selected workspace.
The page reflects the chosen template.
The user can view and edit the new page.
